# HexPiece 2.8.0

Ama no Murakumo as in the anime, from your two frames. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass and it was
rendered and checked off-game.

- **Ama no Murakumo is pure light, no handle:** a long, very thin rod of light (2.6 blocks), white-hot down its core in a pale-gold
  sheath and a soft gold glow, pointed at its tip. At your fist, a ring of light with a cross through it and a starburst of rays
  that flicker. Drawn in the right hand through the arm's own pose, and in first person.
